notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.notes:
Greetings!
For this update we have prepared a little surprise!

> BUG Fix
  - Some NPCs still had flaws and ended up delivering items infinitely (I hope nobody abused it)
- Swordsman class skills are completely updated.

> Graphic Update
- We made some modifications to the maps in order to give more life to the scenario and improve the location of the player within them.

> The renovated and accessible Dragon Temple!
- With a new look, the Dragon Temple can be accessed by players who have already completed the main story. I hope you enjoy what is waiting for you there ...

> Possible future updates
- We are considering the possibility of introducing a kind of "automatic save", we would like your feedback mainly on this issue, and if possible, new suggestions for updating.
Good game!
